title: Surjective morphism of schemes
statement: A morphism of schemes $f:X\to Y$ [def-pc-scheme] is *surjective* if the underlying map of topological spaces $|X|\to|Y|$ is surjective, that is, every point of $Y$ is the image of some point of $X$.
